python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('docs/index.rst')
s = p.read_text()
for start, end in [('.. autoclass:: MRUCache', '.. autoclass:: RRCache'), ('.. decorator:: mru_cache', '.. decorator:: rr_cache')]:
    a = s.index(start)
    b = s.index(end, a)
    s = s[:a] + s[b:]
s = s.replace('all the decorators in this module are thread-safe by default.', 'all the decorators in this module are thread-safe by default, and use a\ncondition variable to prevent concurrent execution for the same cache key.\nCalls with different cache keys can still execute concurrently.')
p.write_text(s)
PY
